source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DO300, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « New 3rd generation XMOS XU-316, PCM support up to 32bit/768kHz, DSD support to DSD512; »; « The new generation flagship DAC chip ES9039MSPRO of USA ESS has built-in MQA hard decoding; »; « USB, optical fiber, coaxial , AES, I2S support DSD transmission, coaxial and optical fiber support DOP64; »; « Qualcomm high-end Bluetooth chip, support LDAC (24bit/96kHz), APTX/HD, SBC, AAC; »

facts.chip: ESS ES9039MSPRO (« The new generation flagship DAC chip ES9039MSPRO of USA ESS »), XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_optical_has_DoP64_and_no_rate: Optical and coaxial get DoP64 from the maker's own clause and no PCM ceiling, because none is stated: copying 768 kHz onto optical is the error vocabulary/why-the-optical-default-stays-low.json exists to prevent.
_AES_and_I2S_carry_DSD_at_an_unstated_ra: « USB, optical fiber, coaxial , AES, I2S support DSD transmission, coaxial and optical fiber support DOP64 »: AES and I2S are said to carry DSD and are NOT in the DoP64 clause. Their blocks are empty - DSD on them is stated, how and how much is not, and no field says « carries DSD » without saying one of those.
